headline: Fentuft Best Build
title: Fentuft Build | Thunder Field combo | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Fentuft is a ranged Lightning Aniimo, and its build is easy. Cast Thunder Field on the target first. It follows the enemy for eight seconds, and any Lightning hit inside it triggers an extra Lightning attack and a Lightning debuff. Then fire Lightning Dart, which damages everything on its path and pulls targets closer. Field first, dart second. Do you use Fentuft? Comment below!

scenes.sub: Follows the target for eight seconds

description: Aniimo Fentuft build: Thunder Field for extra Lightning hits and a debuff, then Lightning Dart to pull enemies in.
